summary: Project is ready to be finalized and published (build/deployment to go live).

existing_features.title: Perform final pre-release verification in the deployed environment to confirm the app is ready to publish/go live, including the end-to-end authenticated submission flow and key user interactions.

new_feature_requests.summary: Finalize the project and publish/go live (run build and deployment process).

Update backend access-control initialization so that calls to `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret` from the frontend during authenticated actor creation never trap when the provided secret is empty/invalid, and do not prevent the actor from being created/usable for normal authenticated user actions (including `submitStory`).

Ensure any authenticated principal can obtain the `#user` permission required by user endpoints (at minimum `submitStory`, `addComment`, `addReview`, `getMySubmissions`, `getCallerUserProfile`, and `saveCallerUserProfile`) without requiring an admin token, using the existing initialization flow already invoked by the frontend.

Keep `checkBackendHeartbeat()` callable without authentication and ensure it reliably returns `true` without trapping so frontend availability checks can consistently distinguish backend reachability from other failures.

projectName: Finalize access-control flow and prepare production deployment
